children.text: Your CVS pharmacy receipt lives in the CVS app if the purchase was tied to your ExtraCare account

— open the app, go to your purchase history, and view or save it. If it wasn't linked, you can still get a copy at the store or recreate an itemized one for your records. CVS receipts are famously long, and they carry the exact details you need for FSA/HSA claims. Here's how to get yours.
Need an itemized copy for your own records instead? Use the
CVS receipt generator
If you've lost a receipt for a real purchase and can't retrieve it, you can
recreate a CVS pharmacy receipt
from your card statement's facts — the store, date, items and total. The
CVS receipt generator

fills in the CVS layout, and you edit the items, tax and totals in a live preview, then download a PDF or PNG. This is for your own records, reimbursement paperwork and bookkeeping — legitimate uses only, never to deceive anyone. To build one from scratch,
open the receipt maker
For a pharmacy other than CVS, start from the
pharmacy receipt
template.

children.text: The key advantage of an itemized receipt is transparency. Instead of displaying only a final amount, it explains exactly what contributed to the transaction total. A well-structured
pharmacy receipt

can distinguish prescription-related purchases, over-the-counter products, personal-care items, medical supplies, discounts, taxes, and payment information without making the document unnecessarily complicated.

children.text: If you lost a receipt from a major retailer, requesting a duplicate directly from that retailer is generally more reliable than recreating its document independently.
If the retailer cannot help, our guide to
proof of purchase without a receipt
lists the records that usually stand in for it.

set.seoTitle: Proof of Purchase Without a Receipt: 6 Ways to Prove It

children.text: Prove a purchase without a receipt using a bank statement, order confirmation, loyalty history, store card lookup or product registration — matched to whoever's asking, and stacked where possible. The receipt is the easiest proof but rarely the only one; most purchases leave several traces, and combining two of them usually settles the matter.
If you are the seller and need to issue the record yourself, see our
proof of purchase receipt
guide.

children.text: To make a receipt of payment, record the date, who paid and who received the money, what the payment was for, the amount paid, the payment method, and any remaining balance — then give it a unique number and sign it.
A receipt of payment (also called a payment receipt) proves money was received, which matters most for cash, deposits and installment payments where there's no bank trail. Here's how to make one.
To skip the blank page, start from the
payment receipt template
, which has these fields laid out.
